snapshot.title: Fix PWA iPhone layout: viewport, canvas fill, and flex sizing
snapshot.description: Game appeared zoomed out and off-centre on iPhone when installed as a PWA. Missing viewport-fit=cover, broken flex+height on iframe, and no CSS fill on Godot canvas.

acceptanceCriteria.text: viewport-fit=cover added to index.html viewport meta
PWA display-mode media query covers landscape iPhones (not just max-width:767px)
iframe flex:1 + height:100% conflict resolved with minHeight:0
Godot canvas fills iframe via width/height:100% on html, body, #canvas
